display_long_description:
Welcome to immerGallery, the ultimate **VR image and video viewer**! 


Immerse in your **VR180, VR360 (2D & 3D), panoramas, and regular 2D & 3D content**! Enjoy VR slideshows with your family and friends in **Multiplayer**.


**No more manual image format selection!** Automatic format recognition displays your media correctly and makes exploring your collection quick and seamless.


Elevate your images with **special effects**. Experience snowfall and rain, butterfly-filled meadows, and falling leaves. Explore environments such as Halloween, St. Patrick's Day, Xmas, and even a hot air balloon, designed for optimal enjoyment of drone-captured images—right from the comfort of your home.


Discover more than **300 included immersive photos** from around the world, featuring Oktoberfest, castles, beaches, and many other destinations. Regular updates provide new content to explore.


Create **VR slideshows with background music and voice-overs** to revisit your favorite memories in an immersive, photorealistic presentation.


Experience **high image quality** developed by industry veterans with extensive expertise in computer graphics and VR.


Browse local media and network libraries through **UPnP and SMB**, and easily download custom ZIP collections from the web.


immerGallery supports media from many cameras and systems, including **Acer SpatialLabs Eyes, Kandao QooCam EGO, Insta360 X5, Insta360 Luna Ultra,** and the **Canon RF 5.2mm VR180 lens**.


Feedback? support@immerVR.com
